uncoveredRules.description: Only authenticated users with a valid JWT may create orders. Anonymous/unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 401.
An order item cannot be added if the product's stockQuantity is 0 or less than the requested quantity. Returns HTTP 422 with a descriptive error.
A shipment status cannot be moved to SHIPPED unless the linked payment has status CAPTURED. Prevents shipping unpaid orders.
Refunds must be requested within 30 calendar days of the payment capture date. Requests outside the window receive HTTP 422.
Only users with the ADMIN role may delete user accounts. Authenticated non-admin users receive HTTP 403.
If an order is submitted with an Idempotency-Key header that has already been used, the API returns HTTP 409 Conflict instead of creating a duplicate.
A single order's totalAmount must not exceed $10,000. Adding an item that would breach this limit returns HTTP 422.
A user may only submit a review for a product if they have at least one DELIVERED order containing that product. Otherwise HTTP 403 is returned.
